name: plesetsk_133
description: Plesetsk Cosmodrome Site 133 (Raduga), pad 133/3. Present only so the G1 gate can drive the shipped seam at the Sentinel-5P launch site. A high-latitude site, which is what makes the site-to-node offset large and the gate sharp.
longitude_convention: east-positive, from 62 deg 53 min 13 s N, 40 deg 51 min 00 s E

corridor.source: NOT A PUBLISHED CORRIDOR. Wide enough to admit the azimuth implied by the published inclination.
